title: lodash (debounce, throttle, cloneDeep)
standardAlternative: structuredClone covers most deep copies, and a debounce or throttle is a closure over setTimeout, clearTimeout and Date.now.
notes: test/test.js is QUnit (qunitjs 2.4.1 with qunit-extras 3.0.0, the versions upstream's devDependencies resolve to) and runs every module at once. Each suite runs the vendored file unchanged through `node --require ../qunit-tap.cjs test/test.js`; the preload registers only the tests of one QUnit module (LODASH_QUNIT_MODULE), prints TAP on stdout and sends qunit-extras' own console output to stderr, so the four modules run as four parallel processes.

test/test.js loads the build under test from ../lodash.js (aliased to shims/lodash.cjs) and evaluates every module's definitions at load time with many other lodash methods, so `_` is a fresh lodash context (runInContext of the pinned package) whose debounce, throttle and cloneDeep are the subject's exports (removed when the subject lacks one). The selected tests call only those three. `lodashStable`, the upstream helper copy of lodash, is the pinned package.
The preload sets the UI flags of `node test/test.js` against the monolithic ../lodash.js build (isModularize false, isStrict false), as upstream's own run does.

qunit-extras' asyncRetries (10 in test/test.js) is capped at 2 and QUnit's testTimeout is 2 s: a failing real-timer test would otherwise run eleven times and overrun the 20 s per-file limit. Exceptions thrown from timer callbacks fail the current test instead of ending the process.

Fuzz targets replace setTimeout, clearTimeout, setInterval, clearInterval, Date (constructor and Date.now) and performance.now with a virtual clock in setup(), before the module is imported; Node's delay clamping (below 1 ms or above 2^31-1 ms becomes 1 ms) is kept.
The Create API is lodash's debounce, throttle and cloneDeep as three named exports.

excluded.match: throttle:test/test.js › lodash.throttle › should clear timeout when `func` is called
excluded.reason: Builds a separate lodash with `_.runInContext` and a mocked `Date.now`, so it exercises lodash's context injection rather than the module's throttle.

excluded.match: throttle:test/test.js › lodash.throttle › should work with a system time of `0`
excluded.reason: Builds a separate lodash with `_.runInContext` and a mocked `Date.now`, so it exercises lodash's context injection rather than the module's throttle.

excluded.match: debounce-throttle:test/test.js › lodash.debounce and lodash.throttle › `_.(debounce|throttle)` should work if the system time is set backwards
excluded.reason: Builds a separate lodash with `_.runInContext` and a mocked `Date.now`, so it exercises lodash's context injection rather than the module's functions.

excluded.match: clone:test/test.js › clone methods › `_.cloneDeep` should return a unwrapped value when chaining
excluded.reason: Calls `_(value).cloneDeep()`, lodash's chaining wrapper, which is outside the API; the wrapper would call lodash's own cloneDeep.

excluded.match: clone:test/test.js › clone methods › `_.cloneDeep` should (not error on|not clone) DOM elements
excluded.reason: Needs a browser `document`; under Node the test skips its assertions, so it passes for any module.

excluded.match: clone:test/test.js › clone methods › `_.cloneDeep` should create an object from the same realm as `value`
excluded.reason: Clones the other-realm values a browser iframe attaches to `_` as `_._realm`; under Node there are none, so it passes for any module.
